DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash on September 10, 2026, and the sources agree on that date. Sources differ on the API name, and some describe a limited beta before the official launch.

- **Launch and replacement:** Reports say the model replaced V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Experimental and lowered API prices. At 12:00 noon Beijing Time on September 10, DeepSeek officially released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and from 04:00 UTC on 14 September, DeepSeek will send every request made to V4-Pro, its top model, to V4.1-Flash instead.
- **Specs:** The model has 552 billion parameters in total and uses a Mixture-of-Experts design. It activates 8 billion parameters per token when reading input and 16 billion when writing output. It handles up to 1 million tokens of context and understands images natively, according to its model card.
- **Performance claims:** DeepSeek says it beats its own flagship on coding and agent tasks, at a lower price. These benchmarks have not been independently verified, according to The Next Web's reporting.
- **Availability and license:** The Hangzhou lab announced it in a thread on X and published the weights on Hugging Face under the MIT licence.
- **API name (conflicting reports):** One source says the API name is deepseek-flash. Another says the call name is deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910, which appears to be the name used during the earlier test period. OpenRouter and LLM Gateway list the model as deepseek-v4.1-flash.
- **Beta period:** A Chinese-language report says the model first ran as a limited test from September 8 to September 10, and that it is not a formal public release. The later September 10 launch reports treat it as the official release.
- **Pricing:** Third-party hosts list it at $0.30/M input tokens and $1.20/M output tokens. Pricing may differ by provider, so check DeepSeek's official API page for current rates.
- **Next model:** That arrangement runs until a V4.1-Pro arrives. DeepSeek gave no date for it.

xAI released Grok Voice 3.0 on October 14, 2026. It is a speech-to-speech model for developers building voice agents, and it became available through the Voice Agent API under the model ID grok-voice-3.0.

- **Architecture:** Unlike pipelines that chain transcription, a language model, and speech synthesis, it handles audio input and output directly. Grok Voice 3.0 is xAI's third-generation speech-to-speech model for real-time voice agents.
- **Target use cases:** xAI aimed it at phone support, contact centers, and in-app assistants.
- **Replacement of prior version:** It took over from Grok Voice 2.0, which xAI now lists as deprecated. The grok-voice-latest alias now points to this release. Teams that did not pin a specific version were upgraded automatically, which changed call behavior for them.
- **Pricing:** xAI held the price flat at $0.08 per minute while retiring its predecessor.
- **Latency:** xAI reports response times under one second.
- **Integration:** The existing WebSocket endpoint, session parameters, and events are unchanged. The API matches the shape of OpenAI's Realtime API.
- **Benchmarks:** Artificial Analysis scored it 86.9 on its speech-to-speech composite index, placing it first. xAI also cites a 74% EVA-Bench accuracy figure, which is a provider-reported claim.
- **Production use:** xAI says the model is already running in Tesla vehicles and the Starlink customer support center.

**Caveats:** Most performance figures come from xAI or are repeated from its announcement. One summary notes that no separate public Artificial Analysis leaderboard page for Grok Voice 3.0 has been confirmed yet. Treat the rankings and percentages as provisional until independent evaluations are published. Also, some secondary sources describe the same launch differently in details like the company's corporate parent, so check xAI's own announcement at x.ai/news/grok-voice-3 for official specifics.

Meta released Muse Wonder 1.0 (model ID `muse-wonder-1.0`) on October 12, 2026, alongside a higher-tier version called Muse Wonder Full. Released by its Superintelligence Lab on October 12, 2026, the models are designed to handle demanding personal and professional tasks. Meta calls them its most capable models so far, and they sit above the cheaper Muse Spark line.

**Access and tiers**
- Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API, OpenRouter, and all Muse Code plans. Muse Wonder Full is limited to the Muse Code Power and Max plans. Muse Wonder Full n'est que dans les forfaits Muse Code Power (50 $/mois) et Max (200 $/mois). Setting Wonder to maximum reasoning effort does not unlock Full, according to Meta's documentation.
- The Muse consumer app is slated to get Wonder later, starting with subscribers, and it still runs on Spark 1.3 for now.

**Capabilities**
- It accepts text, images, video, audio, and PDFs, and outputs text, with a context window of roughly 1 million tokens.
- Reasoning effort is adjustable from minimal to max.
- Meta positions it for coding, long-running agents, and advanced computer use.
- Its API is still labeled as a preview.

**Pricing and limits**
- Pricing is $4 per million input tokens, $20 per million output tokens, and $0.20 per million for cache reads.
- Meta's stated rate limits are 3,000 requests per minute and 4 million tokens per minute.

**Discrepancies to note**
- Third-party listings disagree on maximum output length. Inworld and Requesty list roughly 944K output tokens, while CloudPrice lists 131K. I'd check Meta's own developer documentation for the authoritative figure.

NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on October 15, 2026, as part of a family of open models for agents.

- **What it is:** An open 120-billion-parameter model that works with text, images, charts, web pages, and documents. It combines reasoning and tool use with image and document understanding. Its architecture is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 120B total and 12B active parameters.
- **Availability:** Super VL and Bolt 74B-A9B are available now. Super VL is available through Hugging Face, OpenRouter, and ModelScope, and NVIDIA also offers it through NIM. It is licensed under OpenMDW-1.1 for commercial use.
- **Openness:** NVIDIA is releasing Super VL with open weights and supporting training materials. Its training process covered approximately 26 trillion tokens. Post-training involved around 3.8 million samples, followed by reinforcement learning across dozens of environments.
- **Performance claims:** NVIDIA says it is comparable with NVIDIA's largest reasoning model at roughly one-fifth the parameter count. It also claims the model completes tasks five times faster than the nearest competitor in its class.
- **Independent checks:** Artificial Analysis gave Super VL a 26.5 Intelligence Index score, and measured it at roughly 630 output tokens per second with 100,000-token prompts on a pre-release endpoint. However, one commentary notes that Artificial Analysis does not list Super VL at all as of its writing, so the 5x speed claim is still vendor-reported.
- **Companion models:** The release also included Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, for local agentic workloads, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, for fast conversational agents. Bolt 74B-A9B is designed to fit in 24GB of memory with native 2-bit quantization. The 4GB Bolt E4B model is due October 23.

제가 판단한 지난 7일(10월 11~18일) 동안 가장 중요한 AI 모델 출시 3가지입니다.

1. **Meta Muse Wonder 1.0 (10월 12일)**: Meta 초지능 연구소(Superintelligence Lab)가 발표한 Meta의 가장 강력한 모델로, 텍스트·이미지·영상·오디오·PDF를 입력받고 약 100만 토큰 컨텍스트를 지원하며 코딩·장시간 에이전트 작업·컴퓨터 사용에 맞춰져 있습니다(API는 아직 프리뷰).
   출처: [YourStory](https://yourstory.com/ai-story/muse-wonder-meta-ai-race-frontier-models)

2. **Meta Muse Spark Open (10월 15일)**: 8,160억 파라미터, 100만 토큰 컨텍스트의 멀티모달 오픈 웨이트 모델로, TechCrunch는 미국에서 가장 강력한 오픈 웨이트 모델로 소개했고 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 같은 Apple 실리콘에서 로컬로 실행되도록 설계됐습니다.
   출처: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/meta-launches-an-open-weight-model-that-runs-on-macs/)

3. **xAI Grok Voice 3.0 (10월 14일)**: 음성을 텍스트로 변환하는 단계 없이 오디오를 직접 처리하는 3세대 음성-음성 모델로, 응답 시간은 1초 미만이고 가격은 분당 0.08달러로 그대로이며 Grok Voice 2.0을 대체합니다.
   출처: [DevX](https://www.devx.com/artificial-intelligence-ai/what-is-grok-voice-3-0-xai-speech-to-speech-model/)

**함께 볼 만한 출시:** NVIDIA는 10월 15일 1,200억 파라미터 오픈 멀티모달 모델 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL을 공개했습니다([HPCwire](https://www.hpcwire.com/aiwire/2026/10/15/nvidia-expands-nemotron-family-with-highest-efficiency-super-vl-and-bolt-models/)).

**참고:**
- 대부분 언론과 집계 사이트를 근거로 했고, 각 회사 공식 발표문은 직접 확인하지 못했습니다. 성능 수치는 대부분 회사가 자체 발표한 것입니다.
- 일부 집계 사이트에는 "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017"이 10월 17일 출시로 올라와 있습니다. 하지만 V4.1 Flash 자체는 9월 10일에 나온 모델이고, 이번 업데이트를 확인해 주는 보도는 찾지 못해 목록에서 뺐습니다.
- Gemini 4 Argon은 10월 13일에 개발자 접근이 전면 열렸지만 출시일은 10월 1일이라 제외했습니다.
